title: Builders and Shutterers
experience: Proven experience as a Builder, Shutterer, or similar construction role
description_text:
Outreach Recruitment Agency is looking for skilled Builders and Shutterers on behalf of our client, a leading construction and building-solutions company.
 The successful candidates will be responsible for the assembly, installation, and maintenance of construction frameworks, concrete shuttering, and general building tasks across project sites in Malta. This role is key to ensuring projects are completed safely, efficiently, and to high-quality standards.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Construct, install, and dismantle concrete formwork (shuttering) according to project plans.
 Assist with pouring, leveling, and finishing concrete where required.
 Carry out general building tasks including brick/block work, flooring, and ceiling installation.
 Read and interpret technical drawings and instructions accurately.
 Ensure all work is carried out safely, following site rules and health & safety regulations.
 Maintain tools, equipment, and work areas in good condition.
 Collaborate effectively with site teams to meet project timelines and quality standards.
 Participate in site clean-up and preparation tasks as needed.
 Requirements 
 Proven experience as a Builder, Shutterer, or similar construction role.
 Knowledge of concrete shuttering techniques, formwork assembly, and general building practices.
 Ability to read and understand construction drawings and specifications.
 Physically fit and able to perform manual handling tasks safely.
 Awareness of health and safety regulations on construction sites.
 Reliable, punctual, and able to work independently or as part of a team.
 Flexibility to work on different sites across Malta.
 Relevant trade certificates or qualifications are desirable but not mandatory.
 What's Offered 
 Competitive salary based on experience.
 Full-time employment with a reputable Maltese construction company.
 Opportunity to work on a variety of construction projects across Malta.
 Supportive and professional work environment.
 Career growth opportunities for skilled and motivated workers.
 Join the Team! 
 If you are a skilled Builder or Shutterer looking for a stable, hands-on role in construction, this is your chance to contribute to exciting projects across Malta!
